articles.title: Employment history integration triage
articles.body: For employment-history failures, correlate member and incident time with EmploymentUpdateListener. A Salesforce FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION at the source query is routed to Salesforce. A NetSuite nonexistent external ID error is routed to NetSuite for investigation. Do not infer the root cause from the reporting screen. Request missing incident time before log correlation.

articles.title: NetSuite missing external record
articles.body: A NetSuite nonexistent external ID response can affect queued customer/member upserts. Record the referenced ID and execution evidence, then route to NetSuite. Humans verify record state and resolve the mismatch.

articles.title: ECR cash-sale API rejection
articles.body: A NetSuite API success=false response during cash-sale posting requires NetSuite review. Preserve the API error and correlation details; do not retry or change records automatically.

articles.title: Checkout execution timeout
articles.body: An execution time limit reached while waiting on the NetSuite connector is an investigation lead for NetSuite. Record the active connector and the timeout. Humans establish the underlying cause.

articles.title: Checkout success status guidance
articles.body: The earlier checkout runbook treats SUCCESS execution status as sufficient to conclude the integration completed without a business error.

articles.title: CPD recording help
articles.body: Questions about how to record CPD activity without a reported technical failure go to Education Support.
